title: User-typed secret persists in history.jsonl
reason_not_testable: Typed prompt text is not a tool result, so no PostToolUse or PreToolUse hook sees it, and the e2e runner asserts only tool_response and the final reply, not history.jsonl. Non-hook control: do not type secrets into the prompt box, including '!' shell prompts; purge history.jsonl after sessions.
